page.overview:
Who is King Vegeta?

King Vegeta closely resembles his eldest son, Vegeta, and has the same hairstyle as him, though he is bearded, has brown hair, and is taller than his son. Being a part of Frieza's army, King Vegeta wears a red and white variant of the typical Battle Armor, but with minor customizations, such as having the red Saiyan Royal Family crest on the left chest side of his armor, and donning a blue and red cape held on his armor's shoulder guards by gold anchors, similar to the cape Prince Vegeta wore as a child. With his outfit, King Vegeta also sports a black undersuit, a gold armband on his right arm, white gloves, and dark blue boots, while also wrapping his tail around his waist in a belt-like fashion.

In Dragon Ball Super: Broly, King Vegeta appears with a slight change in his appearance and has a newer design. His face now shows marked cheekbones, longer sideburns, and his beard possessing a thinner gapped mustache. His hair color also seems to be a darker shade of brown but other artworks depict his hair color as black with gray lightings to them. His attire is made up of a black armor with a gold stomach and lower back plate, also possessing gold shoulder guards held for a red cape that is anchored on the upper chest plate by gold anchors. Unlike the original design of King Vegeta, this design of King Vegeta doesn't possess the Saiyan Royal Family crest in the left chest plate of his armor. Underneath the cape and armor he dons, he wears a dark blue tight suit, a gold necklace with a few blue gems, a pair of black wrist guards, a pair of white Frieza Force boots, and a white skirt that possesses a red and gray stripe at the hem, in which his tail is wrapped around on.
